data.title: First outreach message asks one question about their own incident, with no booking link; the call and Calendly come only after they reply
data.why: After 16 touches in two days: 2 replies, 0 bookings. Both repliers answered conversationally, and one asked 'why would I want to chat with you?' — the 30-min ask with a link in message one is being read as a sales sequence. A reply-first opener is cheap to test and reversible; rates are compared per variant in the ledger and re-based at the Dec 14 review
data.rejected: Keep the Calendly link in the first message; Offer a paid incentive for the call
